name: Unstick me
tagline: Asks one small question at a time until a stalled task is actually started
description: Knowing what needs doing and being unable to begin are two different problems, and advice for the first rarely helps the second. This one works through a single brief prompt at a time, narrowing the job until the first move feels small enough to make. If it is still too big, it helps you pick a smaller one.
author: YanqingCheng
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
